label: Bone Reliquary King first encounter

purpose.value: Among the graves he tends, the caretaker of the ancestral sanctuary greets the armed stranger, speaks the ancestors' names, and issues the law's fair warning before any blow is struck; the hero hears every word and misreads remembrance as necromancy. The guardian attempts communication first; the hero misreads it as a villain's taunt.

emotionalProgression.note: The guardian announces itself and its duty plainly, framed by graves and the names of the dead.
The warning was honest and complete; being ignored reads as insult.

notes: The scene MUST establish the guardian announcing itself and warning honestly — the law of fair warning means its attack paths will be shown, not hidden. The mercy exit (withdraw) is offered and never taken. Flavor: graves and the names of the dead. The player's view may hint the guardian's true role; the hero must not perceive it.
